canonical_project: Ark Spring Park DC7 extension (Donkey Field)
owner: Ark Data Centres / Ark Estates 4 Ltd

location.country: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

notes: Wiltshire Council Strategic Planning Committee approved application PL/2024/05527 (10-11 Feb 2026) for a ~GBP250m standalone data centre building (18.7m tall data hall, 27,350 sqm per DCD) plus security/access on the 18-acre Donkey Field site at Spring Park, Neston/Corsham, extending Ark's existing campus; decision followed >1,100 public objections on flooding/noise.
